scope: P1 evidence, local telemetry and cooperative resources
adopted_now: code evidence gate using structured executable checks
local ledger telemetry with explicit unknown provider capacity
cooperative named-resource lock with owner, TTL and owner-checked release
deferred: runtime adapter requiring host spawn/cancel/permission callbacks
provider slot/load hard filtering and external usage telemetry
boundaries: evidence gate uses test/build/repro command results as the code oracle
research evidence keeps final_verdict null and does not write research-state or mutate frozen contracts
telemetry aggregates only local durable ledger observations
resource locks are cooperative protocol locks, not runtime sandbox enforcement
